title: 空位的词性判断
goal: 根据句子功能和完整结构判断空位所需的词性。

points.label: 确定空位在句中的语法功能
根据完整结构判断所需词性

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 空位在句中承担主语、宾语、表语、定语或状语等功能。判断词性时，先找句子主干，再检查修饰语。
主语、宾语等功能也可由短语或从句承担。选词填空每空只填一个词，本课只讲单个词的词性。

cards.title: 主语、宾语与表语
rows: 句首名词作动作的主体
Patience improves communication. / Experience changes expectations.
The team reviewed evidence. / The guide described routes.
They discussed the effect on employment. / The plan relies on cooperation.
系动词后可用形容词描述主语
The room became quiet. / The explanation seems plausible.
主语后用限定动词陈述动作
The river flows east. / The device measures pressure.

cards.title: 定语与状语
rows: a flexible schedule / a reliable source
冠词后可先有形容词，再接名词
a detailed report / an early decision
The train moved slowly. / The speaker responded calmly.
a highly effective filter / a surprisingly complex design
Fortunately, the package arrived. / Apparently, the office was closed.
cards.note: 判断空位时须辨认整个名词短语。例如 a detailed report 中，detailed 修饰名词 report。

items.stem: In 'The committee examined the proposal', what function does 'the proposal' have?
items.why: the proposal 是 examined 的宾语，即第二项。

items.stem: In 'The surface became rough', what function does 'rough' have?
items.why: rough 位于系动词 became 后，描述主语，即第四项。

items.stem: Which word completes 'The editor gave a useful ___ of the chapter'?
items.why: a useful 修饰名词 description，即第三项。

items.stem: Which word completes 'The road became ___ after the rain'?
items.why: became 后用形容词 slippery 描述 road，即第一项。

items.stem: In 'The technician checked the instrument carefully', what does 'carefully' modify?
items.why: carefully 修饰动词 checked，说明检查的方式，即第三项。

items.stem: Which word completes 'The figures changed ___ over the year'?
items.why: 副词 gradually 修饰动词 changed，即第二项。

items.stem: In 'Cooperation reduced the delay', what function does 'Cooperation' have?
items.why: Cooperation 是谓语 reduced 的主语，即第一项。

items.stem: In 'The workshop needs skilled workers', what function does 'skilled' have?
items.why: skilled 修饰名词 workers，在名词前作定语，即第四项。

items.stem: In 'The old engine runs smoothly', what function does 'smoothly' have?
items.why: smoothly 描述 runs 的方式，作状语，即第二项。

items.stem: Which word completes 'The report provides a detailed ___ of the project'?
items.why: a detailed 后需要名词 evaluation，即第三项。

items.stem: Which word completes 'The sample remained ___ during transport'?
items.why: 系动词 remained 后用形容词 stable 描述 sample，即第一项。

items.stem: Which word completes 'The audience listened ___ to the explanation'?
items.why: 副词 attentively 修饰 listened，即第四项。
